queryResults.name: incidents_join_systems
queryResults.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM incidents i JOIN communication_systems s ON s.id=i.system_id

queryResults.name: maintenance_linked_incidents
queryResults.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM maintenance_tasks m JOIN incidents i ON i.id=m.incident_id

queryResults.name: mapped_action_departments
queryResults.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM team_organizations o JOIN maintenance_teams t ON t.id=o.team_id JOIN organization_units u ON u.id=o.unit_id

queryResults.name: fictional_roster_members
queryResults.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM organization_members m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE m.is_demo=1

queryResults.name: recurring_generated_occurrences
queryResults.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM recurring_occurrences r JOIN maintenance_tasks m ON m.id=r.task_id
